prompt: Create a hyper-realistic vertical close-up selfie-style photo from inside a clear plastic cup, looking upward through a circular transparent rim. A young Japanese woman, early 20s, leans very close to the camera and sips through one thick teal-green straw centered in extreme perspective, running from the bottom foreground directly to her puckered lips. She has soft fair skin, large glossy brown eyes, natural makeup, rosy cheeks, long eyelashes, and reddish-brown hair in a loose side braid with wispy bangs and flyaway strands. She wears a delicate white lace blouse with ruffled shoulders and dangling pearl earrings. The cup foreground contains bright red strawberry pieces and crushed ice, heavily blurred with sparkling highlights and condensation; the cup rim forms a translucent circular frame around her face. Background: a sunny Japanese shopping street or festival lane with traditional wooden storefronts, blue sky, leafy trees, colorful hanging banners, and one visible banner with a strawberry motif, all softly out of focus. Lighting is bright midday sunlight with backlit hair glow, lens flare, glittering bokeh on the ice, cheerful summer atmosphere. Use an ultra-wide macro perspective, shallow depth of field, realistic skin texture, crisp focus on her eyes and lips, vibrant colors, vertical 9:16 composition. Include exactly one visible straw, one main subject, one cup rim circle, and multiple strawberry chunks in the foreground; avoid extra people in focus, avoid text overlays, watermark, or cartoon styling.

promptZh: 创作一张超写实的竖构图近景自拍风格照片，视角位于透明塑料杯内部，透过圆形的透明杯沿向上仰望。一位年轻的日本女性，20 岁出头，非常靠近镜头，正通过一根居中的粗青绿色吸管啜饮，吸管从底部前景直接延伸至她微嘟的嘴唇，呈现极端的透视效果。她拥有白皙细腻的皮肤、明亮的大眼睛、自然妆容、红润脸颊、长睫毛，以及梳成松散侧编发的红棕色头发，配有轻盈的刘海和碎发。她身穿精致的白色蕾丝衬衫，肩部带有荷叶边设计，并佩戴垂坠珍珠耳环。杯子前景包含鲜红的草莓块和碎冰，带有强烈的模糊效果、闪烁的高光和冷凝水珠；杯沿在她的脸部周围形成一个半透明的圆形框架。背景：阳光明媚的日本商业街或节日小巷，有传统的木质店面、蓝天、绿叶树木、色彩鲜艳的悬挂横幅，其中一个横幅带有草莓图案，所有背景均经过柔焦处理。光线为明亮的正午阳光，头发带有逆光光晕，镜头光晕，冰块上闪烁着焦外成像，营造出欢快的夏季氛围。采用超广角微距视角，浅景深，真实的皮肤纹理，眼睛和嘴唇清晰对焦，色彩鲜艳，9:16 竖构图。画面中仅包含一根可见的吸管、一个主体、一个杯沿圆环以及前景中的多个草莓块；避免出现焦点清晰的额外人物，避免文字叠加、水印或卡通风格。
